## Summary

Describe the focused change and its user impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and contains no unrelated feature additions.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated and pass.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Any fixtures are synthetic only.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for UI changes and contain synthetic data only.
- [ ] No secrets, real career data, or personal paths are included.
